title: Researcher - Institute of Computational Science and Artificial Intelligence
institution: Van Lang University, Institute of Computational Science and Artificial Intelligence
about: Van Lang University's careers page lists a Researcher role at its Institute of Computational Science and Artificial Intelligence (Main Campus), deadline 31 December 2026. The institute says it is recruiting 10 full- and part-time researchers with doctoral degrees, regardless of nationality.
requirements: Full-time and part-time researchers of any nationality are recruited (institute page)

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Researcher (doctoral degree holders)" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Artificial intelligence" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
